svg.aria-label: Fewkit: one front door to a lean Claude Code setup. A relay baton rests on two roller cradles: an orange cap (CodeKickoff), three white grip rings that get shorter (Fewturns), and a blue-to-violet tube (Laneboard), engraved FEWKIT.
svg.text: CAP · GRIP · TUBE = KICKOFF · FEWTURNS · LANEBOARD

g.text: One front door to a lean
CodeKickoff on day one, Fewturns every day,
Laneboard for every project at a glance.
